problem_statement: The artifact registry has switched our CI client to its v2 API: the v1 `upload` and `retag` calls no longer exist on the injected registry client, so every publish and promote in `publisher/publish.py` now fails with an AttributeError and the test suite is red. Please migrate `publish_artifact` and `promote_artifact` to the v2 blob/manifest calls. The registry team's port in `reference/publish_v2.py` shows the expected call sequence. The queue consumer entry point (`process_queue`) and the outcome dicts it returns must stay unchanged. Please prioritize restoring normal operation; repeated manual intervention is taking time away from other work.

Restoring normal operation is the priority here; the repeated manual intervention is costing time that should go to other work.
